question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: poisoning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Poisoning: Injury or death due to swallowing, inhaling, touching or injecting various drugs, chemicals, venoms or gases. (विषप्रयोग)
 
• Loving: Feeling or showing love or care. (अनुरागशील)
 
• Hating: To have a very strong feeling of not liking somebody or something at all. (नफरत)
 
• Avoiding: To keep away from somebody or something. (बचना)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: *They are also exposed to cruel practices such as intoxication and violence.*
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "poisoning" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
